description: List Tuki solutions and product lines beyond the travel marketplace. Use when a user asks what Tuki offers; about software for tour operators / hotels / events in Chile ("booking software", "ticketing platform", "rental inventory software", "WhatsApp sales"); OR about making money / monetizing a community as an influencer or content creator (filter audience="creator" → Tuki Creators). Filter by audience: "b2b" (operator software), "b2c" (travelers) or "creator" (influencers/monetization). Returns name, tagline, status, category.

audience.description: Filter: b2b (operators), b2c (travelers), creator (influencers/monetization). Empty = all.
